envelope.text: Present only with the platform clock — see the module note.

why: phase-515 R3, was `declined`/`absent` with the whole log-modifier family. Sets the `ThrottleClock`, of which ours has one variant (`rust:ThrottleClock`), and like `rust:ToLogParams::throttle` exists only with the platform clock, which is why the clockless report lists it theirs-only.
